name: DescribeDtsJobDetail

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking instance
parameters.name: dts_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
Forward: forward.
Reverse: reverse.

The default value is Forward.
The value Reverse takes effect only when the synchronization topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
同步方向，取值：
Forward：正向。
Reverse：反向。

默认取值为Forward。
只有当数据同步实例的同步拓扑为双向同步时，本参数传入Reverse才会生效
parameters.name: synchronization_direction

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the task. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return information about all synchronization subtasks. Default value: false, which returns only the subtask that is in progress or the most recently executed subtask
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回全部同步子任务的信息，默认为false，只返回正在进行中或者最近一次执行的同步子任务
parameters.name: sync_sub_job_history

parameters.help_en:
